y-m-70-01.topic: Sassan conic: ma’anar parabola (focus, directrix) da tazara
y-m-70-01.goal: Nemo layin da ke da kuskure a mafitar da ta yi amfani da ma’anar parabola (tazara zuwa focus da directrix iri ɗaya), bincika amsa da hanyar da ba ta maimaita kuskuren ba, sannan ka gwada dangantakar da aka gyara da maki na musamman.
y-m-70-01.material: Wannan matsala tana neman duk maki P a parabola y²=12x da tazararsa PF daga focus F zuwa P take 9. (Coordinate plane; ba a nuna raka’ar tsawo ba. y² ana karanta shi “y squared”.) Mafitar Minjae tana mataki na farko.

y-m-70-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bincika layi bayan layi ko kowanne ya biyo daga layin da ya gabace shi da gaske.
y-m-70-01.s.s1.hint.1: Yi alama da −3 da maki x=1 a layin lambobi, ka ƙirga tazararsu kai tsaye, sannan ka kwatanta da ƙimar da aka samu idan an saka x=1 cikin furucin layi na 3.
y-m-70-01.s.s1.line.0: y²=12x parabola y²=4px ce inda p=3, saboda haka focus F(3;0) ne kuma directrix x=−3.
y-m-70-01.s.s1.line.1: Ga maki P(x,y) a kan parabola, tazarar PF daga P zuwa focus ta yi daidai da tazarar P zuwa directrix.
y-m-70-01.s.s1.line.2: Tazara daga P zuwa directrix x=−3 ita ce x−3.
y-m-70-01.s.s1.line.3: PF=9, saboda haka x−3=9, wato x=12.
y-m-70-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne ya kuskure. Directrix x=−3 ce, maki parabola kuma suna da x≥0, don haka P yana dama da directrix. Tazarar P zuwa directrix ba x−3 ba ce, sai x−(−3)=x+3. Idan aka gyara, x+3=9, x=6, y²=72, saboda haka P(6;6√2) ko P(6;−6√2). Layuka 4 da 5 sun gada kuskuren layi na 3.
y-m-70-01.s.s2.prompt: Wace hanya ce mafi amfani domin tabbatar da cewa amsar Minjae P(12, 12) ba amsar matsalar ba ce?
y-m-70-01.s.s2.hint.0: Dubawa na nufin saka amsar cikin 'sharadin da matsalar ta nema', ba cikin 'abin da mafita ta samar' ba. Mene ne sharadin matsalar?
y-m-70-01.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta ƙimar da za ka samu idan ka lissafa sharadin kai tsaye da P(12, 12).
y-m-70-01.s.s2.o.a: Bi mafitar Minjae daga farko ka sake rubuta ta, ka duba ko amsa iri ɗaya za ta fito.
y-m-70-01.s.s2.r.a: Maimaita mafita ɗaya yana maimaita kuskure ɗaya. Ba dubawa ce mai zaman kanta daga mafitar ba.
y-m-70-01.s.s2.o.b: Saka wurin P(12, 12) da aka samu domin duba ko ya cika y²=12x.
y-m-70-01.s.s2.r.b: P(12, 12) ainihin wuri ne a kan parabola. Wannan dubawar ta nuna cewa ba ta gwada sashen da kuskure yake ba (sharadin tazara).
y-m-70-01.s.s2.o.c: Lissafa tazarar P(12, 12) da F(3, 0), sannan ka duba ko 9 ce.
y-m-70-01.s.s2.r.c: Wannan hanya tana gwada sharadin matsalar kai tsaye kuma dabam da mafita.
y-m-70-01.s.s2.o.d: Tun da amsar ta fito da haɗin gwiwa cikakku masu kyau, a yi tunanin mai yiwuwa daidai ce.
y-m-70-01.s.s2.r.d: Kyan rubutu ba hujjar daidaito ba ne. Ba ya duba ko amsar ta cika sharadin da ake buƙata.
y-m-70-01.s.s2.explain: Tazarar P(12, 12) da F(3, 0) ita ce √(9²+12²)=√225=15, ba 9 ba. Gwajin ko P tana kan parabola amsar mafita mara kyau ma za ta cika, saboda haka ba ya gano kuskure. Lissafa sharadin matsalar (PF=9) kai tsaye kuma dabam da mafita shi ne dubawa mai zaman kanta.
y-m-70-01.s.s3.prompt: Mu gwada ko dangantakar da aka gyara 'PF=x+3' daidai ce. Nemo maki 2 P(x, y) a kan parabola y²=12x inda x da y duka cikakkun lambobi ne, kuma x ya bambanta; ga kowane maki lissafa ka rubuta tazara d zuwa F(3, 0) kai tsaye da dabarar nisan tsakanin maki biyu.
y-m-70-01.s.s3.hint.0: A y²=12x, nemo ƙimomin x kamar x=3, 12, 27 inda 12x yake cikakken murabba'i, sannan ka nemo y.
y-m-70-01.s.s3.hint.1: Yi murabba'in bambancin haɗin gwiwar wurin da ka samu da na F(3, 0), tara su, ɗauki tushen murabba'i, sannan ka kwatanta da x+3.
y-m-70-01.s.s3.var.d: PF (ƙimar da aka lissafa kai tsaye)
y-m-70-01.s.s3.ok.c1: x da y cikakkun lambobi ne.

y-m-70-01.s.s3.fail.c2: Wurin ba ya kan parabola. Duba ko murabba'in y daidai yake da 12x.

y-m-70-01.s.s3.fail.c3: d ya bambanta da tazarar P da F(3, 0). Lissafa (x−3)²+y².
y-m-70-01.s.s3.explain: Misali, a (3, 6), d=6=3+3; a (12, 12), d=15=12+3; a (27, 18), d=30=27+3. A kowane maki PF=x+3 ya tabbata. Don haka PF=9 yana faruwa ne kawai idan x=6, sannan y²=72, saboda haka amsoshin wannan matsala ba maki masu haɗin gwiwa cikakku ba ne.

y-m-70-09.prereq.2: Diskriminant na daidaiton digiri na biyu
y-m-70-09.title: Idan layi ya haɗu da parabola a maki guda, shin tangent ne?
y-m-70-09.prereq.0: A ɗauka ɗalibin yana koyon zaɓin Geometry na makarantar sakandare. “H2” alamar wahala da tallafi ce kawai ga wannan aikin, ba yana nufin Ma’aikatar Ilimi ta ware shi ga wani aji ba.
y-m-70-09.topic: Sassan conic: matsayin parabola da layi, layukan tangent
y-m-70-09.goal: Tantance da’awar “idan sun haɗu a wuri guda tangent ne” ta bayanin tebur, nemo misalin karo da ƙa’ida, gina ma’auratan (m,n) masu tangent ga parabola, sannan bayyana yanayin da discriminant ba zai iya bambancewa ba.
y-m-70-09.material:
Akwai parabola C: y²=4x da layi l_m: y=mx+1 (m lambar gaske ce). Jisu ya ce, “Layin da ya haɗu da parabola a wuri guda tangent ne.” Ga sakamakon saka layin cikin lissafin C da sauƙaƙawa da wuraren haɗuwa:
m | lissafi bayan sakawa | haɗuwa
−1 | x²−6x+1=0 | maki biyu
0 | −4x+1=0 | wuri guda (1/4,1)
1 | x²−2x+1=0 | wuri guda (1,2)
2 | 4x²+1=0 | babu
Lura: tangent a wuri (x₁,y₁) a C shi ne y₁·y=2(x+x₁). (4, 1, 1, 2)
y-m-70-09.thinking.0: Tantance da’awa ta amfani da shaidar tebur
y-m-70-09.thinking.1: Kafa sharadin tangent da gina misalai da yawa
y-m-70-09.prereq.1: Tangent y₁y=2(x+x₁) a (x₁,y₁) na parabola y²=4x
y-m-70-09.s.s1.prompt: Tantance maganar Jisu ta tebur da bayanin kula a matsayin shaida.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.hint.0: Ga layuka biyu da suka haɗu a wuri guda (m=0, m=1), nemo tangent a kowane wurin haɗuwa ta lissafin tangent, sannan ka kwatanta layin.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.hint.1: Zana hoto ka kwatanta alkiblar layin da siffar parabola.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.o.a: Daidai ne. A tebur, duk layukan da suka haɗu a wuri ɗaya (m=0 da m=1) tangent ne.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.r.a: Ba ka duba ko layin m=0 iri ɗaya ne da tangent a (1/4,1). (1, 4)
y-m-70-09.s.s1.o.b: Ba daidai ba ne. Layi m=0 ya haɗu a wuri guda amma ba tangent ba ne.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya nemo misalin karya da’awa kuma ya bincika dalilinsa (ya bambanta da tangent).
y-m-70-09.s.s1.o.c: Ba za a yanke hukunci ba. Layuka huɗu ne kawai a tebur.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.r.c: Ko yawan layuka nawa ne, misali guda na karya “idan ya haɗu a wuri guda, tangent ne.”
y-m-70-09.s.s1.o.d: Ba daidai ba ne. Tangent koyaushe yana haɗuwa da parabola a wurare biyu.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya saɓa wa ma’anar tangent cewa yana taɓa a wuri ɗaya.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.explain: Layin y=1 mai m=0 yana haɗuwa da C a (1/4,1), amma tangent a wurin shi ne y=2x+1/2, daban da y=1. Layi y=1 yana layi ɗaya da axis x na parabola, don haka ko da ya haɗu sau ɗaya ba tangent ba ne. Misali guda ya karya da’awar Jisu. A gefe guda, m=1 iri ɗaya ne da tangent y=x+1, saboda haka tangent ne. (1, 4)
y-m-70-09.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri ma’aurata 3 (m,n) masu m daban inda y=mx+n tangent ne ga parabola y²=4x. (Cire layukan parallel da axis da na x=k; ana iya amfani da adadin goma.)
y-m-70-09.s.s2.hint.0: Saka y=mx+n cikin y²=4x ka rubuta bayani a x. Shin quadratic ne?
y-m-70-09.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin wane yanayi na mafitar lissafin ke nufin tangent, sannan ka kafa sharadi ta discriminant.
y-m-70-09.s.s2.fail.c1: Idan m=0, layin yana parallel da axis na parabola, saboda haka ba tangent ba ne.
y-m-70-09.s.s2.ok.c2: Layin y=mx+n tangent ne ga y²=4x.
y-m-70-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Saka y=mx+n cikin y²=4x domin samun quadratic a x, sannan saita sharadin samun tushen sau biyu.
y-m-70-09.s.s2.explain: Sake tsara (mx+n)²=4x yana ba m²x²+(2mn−4)x+n²=0; discriminant (2mn−4)²−4m²n²=16−16mn=0 yana ba mn=1. Don haka y=mx+1/m (m≠0) tangent ne. Misalai: (1,1),(2,1/2),(−1,−1). x=0 (axis y) ba layin y=mx+n ba ne amma tangent ne a vertex. (2, 1, 1, 1)
y-m-70-09.s.s3.prompt: Ga y=1 da ya haɗu da parabola sau ɗaya amma ba tangent ba, ta yaya ya saɓa wa gwajin tangent ta discriminant bayan sakawa? Bayyana a taƙaice.
y-m-70-09.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta degree da ake buƙata domin discriminant ya iya nuna tushen sau biyu.
y-m-70-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka ce idan m=0 linear ne, ba quadratic ba?
y-m-70-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bambanta “ya haɗu wuri guda” da “tangent ne”?
y-m-70-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka yi tunanin dalilin da ya sa layi parallel da axis ya zama na musamman ga parabola?
y-m-70-09.s.s3.model.0: Idan m=0, bayanin da aka saka linear ne kuma mafita guda yake da shi. Ba za a yi amfani da discriminant domin neman tushen sau biyu ba; layin yana parallel da axis, don haka ko da ya haɗu sau ɗaya ba tangent ba ne.
y-m-70-09.s.s3.model.1: Discriminant 0 yana nufin quadratic tana da tushe sau biyu, saboda haka layin tangent ne. Layi parallel da axis yana ba da linear, ba a amfani da sharadin discriminant duk da yana haɗuwa a wuri guda. Saboda haka haɗuwa sau ɗaya ba ta tabbatar da tangent.

y-m-70-03.prereq.0: A ɗauka ɗalibin yana koyon zaɓin Geometry na makarantar sakandare. “H2” alamar wahala da tallafi ce kawai ga wannan aikin, ba yana nufin Ma’aikatar Ilimi ta ware shi ga wani aji ba.
y-m-70-03.title: Shin layin da gangararsa iri ɗaya da asymptote ba ya taɓa hyperbola?
y-m-70-03.topic: Sassan conic: matsayin asymptote na hyperbola da layi
y-m-70-03.goal: Gwada faɗaɗa iƙirarin da aka gina ta saka asymptote cikin lissafi zuwa wasu layuka, gyara hukuncinka, sannan ka ƙirƙiri misalan layuka masu gangara iri ɗaya.
y-m-70-03.material: Asymptote na hyperbola H: x²/4−y²/9=1 (karanta: x murabba'i bisa 4 a cire y murabba'i bisa 9 daidai 1) su ne y=(3/2)x da y=−(3/2)x. Soyoung ta ce: “Layin da gangararsa iri ɗaya da asymptote ba ya taɓa H. Asymptote yana ƙara kusantowa H ba tare da taɓa shi ba.” Mu tantance maganar Soyoung ta hanyar duba kayan da ke ƙasa ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
y-m-70-03.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci kan faɗaɗa iƙirari daga shaida marar cikawa.
y-m-70-03.thinking.1: Gyara hukuncinka da tabbaci bisa sabon bayani.
y-m-70-03.thinking.2: Gina misalan layukan da suka cika sharadi.
y-m-70-03.prereq.2: Saka lissafin layi cikin lissafin hyperbola, sannan ka sauƙaƙa.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.prompt: Yayin da ake nuna kayan a matakai, zaɓi hukuncinka na yanzu game da maganar Soyoung.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.hint.0: Bambanta ko abin da aka tabbatar zuwa yanzu 'asymptote kanta' ce kawai ko duk layuka masu gangara iri ɗaya.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.hint.1: Yi tunanin abin da zai faru idan ka saka layi mai gangara iri ɗaya amma ba asymptote ba, kamar y=(3/2)x+1.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Saka asymptote y=(3/2)x cikin lissafin H yana ba da x²/4−((3/2)x)²/9=x²/4−x²/4=0, wato 0 ga ko wace x. Ba zai iya zama 1 ba, saboda haka asymptote ba ya taɓa H.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Bayan ganin wannan bayani, mene ne hukuncinka game da maganar Soyoung (kowane layi mai gangara iri ɗaya ba ya taɓa H)?
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.after: An tabbatar da cewa asymptote kanta ba ta taɓa H. Amma maganar Soyoung ta shafi duk layuka masu gangara iri ɗaya, saboda haka ba a gwada sauran layuka ba tukuna.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ina ganin daidai ce, amma asymptote ɗaya kawai aka duba, don haka tabbaci nawa rauni ne.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka tabbatar cewa asymptote kanta ba ta taɓa H. Har yanzu ba ka gwada sauran layukan masu gangara iri ɗaya ba.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Lokaci bai yi da za a yanke hukunci ba. Dole ne a gwada sauran layuka masu gangara iri ɗaya.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Maganar ta ce 'duk layukan da gangararsu iri ɗaya'. Ka san layin da aka gani zuwa yanzu ɗaya ne kawai daga cikinsu.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ba daidai ba ne. Kowane layi mai gangara iri ɗaya yana taɓa H.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan ya saɓa wa bayanin cewa asymptote ba ya taɓa ta. Hukunci ne da aka ayyana akasin haka ba tare da shaida ba.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Saka layin y=(3/2)x+1 mai gangara iri ɗaya cikin lissafin H yana ba da x²/4−((3/2)x+1)²/9=−x/3−1/9=1. Saboda haka x=−10/3, y=(3/2)(−10/3)+1=−4, kuma yana taɓa H a (−10/3,−4). (Duba: (100/9)/4−16/9=25/9−16/9=1.)
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Bayan ganin wannan sabon bayani, mene ne hukuncinka game da maganar Soyoung?
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Maki (−10/3,−4) yana cika lissafin H da na layin duka, saboda haka misalin ƙaryatawa ne. Misalin ƙaryatawa guda yana sa faɗaɗawar Soyoung ta zama ƙarya.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Lissafin dole ya yi kuskure. Idan gangara iri ɗaya ce da ta asymptote, ba za su iya taɓa juna ba.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ne da ya ƙoƙarta riƙe imanin farko ba tare da yin lissafin dubawa ba (ko maki yana cika lissafin H) da kansa.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Wannan layin ba zai zama misalin ƙaryatawa ba domin gangararsa ba iri ɗaya da ta asymptote ba ce.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Gangarar y=(3/2)x+1 ita ce 3/2, iri ɗaya da ta asymptote. Sake duba sharadin misalin ƙaryatawa.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Maganar Soyoung ƙarya ce. Akwai layi mai gangara iri ɗaya da ke taɓa H.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan hukunci ne da misalin ƙaryatawa guda ya rushe iƙirarin 'idan gangara iri ɗaya ce, ba ya taɓawa'.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Gabaɗaya, saka y=(3/2)x+k yana ba da −(k/3)x−k²/9=1, lissafi madaidaici ne a x. Idan k=0 ba sa haɗuwa; idan k≠0, x=−(k²+9)/(3k) ƙima guda ce tsayayyiya, saboda haka suna haɗuwa a wuri guda daidai.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ta yaya za ka gyara maganar Soyoung ta zama jimla daidai?
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Duka b da d gaskiya ne. b ma yana bayyana wane layi ne a wane yanayi (k=0 ko k≠0), d kuma yana faɗin sakamakon da zai yiwu kawai.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Layi mai gangara iri ɗaya kullum yana haɗuwa da H a maki biyu.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Domin maki biyu su fito, lissafin da aka samu bayan sakawa dole ya zama quadratic. A bayani na sama lissafin madaidaici ne.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: A cikin layukan masu gangara iri ɗaya, asymptote kanta ce kaɗai ba ta haɗuwa da H; sauran suna haɗuwa da ita a wuri guda.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka bayyana duk yanayi ta raba zuwa k=0 da k≠0.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Soyoung tana da gaskiya. Misalin ƙaryatawa ya samo asali ne daga kuskuren lissafi.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka ɗauki sakamakon da aka duba ta matakai biyu a matsayin kuskure.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Layi mai gangara iri ɗaya ko dai ba ya taɓa H ko ya haɗu da ita a wuri guda (ba a maki biyu ba).
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan jimla ce daidai da ta shafi duk yanayi. Ba ta bayyana wane yanayi ke ba da wace hanya ba.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.reflect: Da farko za ka iya gaskata 'babu wanda ke haɗuwa' daga asymptote ɗaya, amma faɗaɗa iƙirari yana da wuya a tabbatar daga misali guda. A bayani na gaba, layi mai gangara iri ɗaya ya taɓa H kuma iƙirarin ya rushe; bayani na ƙarshe kuma ya nuna daidai 'lokacin da ba sa haɗuwa'. Ka faɗi wane ɓangaren bayanin ne ya sa ka sauya hukuncinka.

y-m-70-05.title: Idan aka yanka sphere da jirgi, shin sashen da aka samu kullum da’ira ne?

8 | (x−1)²+(y−2)²=0 | maki guda (1; 2; 8)
9 | (x−1)²+(y−2)²=−11 | babu maki haɗuwa

y-m-70-07.material: Akwai alwatika ABC (maki ukun ba a layi guda suke ba), kuma an rubuta maki P da AP=s·AB+t·AC. (AP, AB, AC vectors ne, s da t kuma lambobi ne na gaske. Karanta “vector AP equals s times vector AB plus t times vector AC”.) Yi la’akari da yanayin da P yake cikin alwatika ABC.

y-m-70-08.title: Inuwar farantin karkata: wace ƙa’ida yankinsa ke bi?
y-m-70-08.topic: Daskararru a sarari: yankin juyawar tsaye da kusurwar jirage
y-m-70-08.goal: Tantance ƙa’idojin takara da dama ɗaya bayan ɗaya da bayanan ma’auni, daidaita tabbaci, sannan ka bayyana da murabba’i dalilin da ya sa yankin juyawar tsaye yake cosθ ninkin yankin asali.
y-m-70-08.material: Akwai farantin hasken rana murabba’i mai gefen 6 m. An sanya gefensa ɗaya layi ɗaya da ƙasa (a kwance), sannan aka karkatar da farantin a kusa da wannan gefe a matsayin axis; bari kusurwar da yake yi da ƙasa ta zama θ. A ɗauka hasken rana yana faɗowa a tsaye da ƙasa, mu duba bayanan da ake aunawa ɗaya bayan ɗaya game da yankin inuwa S(θ) (juyawar tsaye) a ƙasa. Akwai ƙa’idojin takara uku. (가) S=36·cosθ, (나) S=36·(1−θ/90°), (다) S=36·cos²θ. (cos ana karanta shi “cosine”, cos²θ kuma “cosine theta squared”.)

y-m-70-08.prereq.2: Rabon trigonometri cosθ da ƙimominsa ga kusurwoyi na musamman (0°,45°,60°,90°)

y-m-70-08.s.s1.hint.0: A kwatanta a tebur ƙimar da ake samu ta saka θ cikin kowane zato da ƙimar da aka auna.

y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yanzu wane hukunci kake da shi game da zato ukun?
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.0.after: Dukkan zato ukun suna ba 36 a θ=0° da 0 a θ=90°, saboda haka bayanin nan kaɗai ba ya bambanta su. Za a iya ɗaukar zato da aka fara sani a matsayin hasashe, amma shaidar ba ta da ƙarfi tukuna.

y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka fi karkata ga ƙa’idar da ka fara sani. Ka duba ko bayanin nan kaɗai ya cire sauran zato.

y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan hukunci ne bayan an tabbatar da saka θ=0° da 90° a zato ukun yana ba 36 da 0.
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.0.o.c: (나) daidai ne. A dabi’ance faɗi yana raguwa daidai da ƙarin kusurwa.
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan hukunci ya fito daga tunanin “rabon da ya fi sauƙi shi ne daidai.”
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.0.o.d: (다) daidai ne. Siffar da ta ƙare da 0 murabba’i ce.
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya duba siffar lissafi kaɗai, ba bayanan ba.
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.1.info: An auna S=18 m² a θ=60°.
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Hasashen ukun su ne (가) 36·cos60°, (나) 36·(1−60/90), (다) 36·cos²60°. Wane hukunci kake da shi bayan ganin bayanin?
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.1.o.a: (나) har yanzu yana yiwuwa. 60° kashi biyu bisa uku ne na 90°, saboda haka dabi’a ce faɗi ya ragu da kashi biyu bisa uku.
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan ya yi hasashen cewa faɗi yana raguwa daidai da kusurwa. (나) yana ba 12, nesa da ainihin 18.

y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan hukunci ne ta kwatanta ƙimomin zato ukun a θ=60° da ƙimar da aka auna.
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.2.info: An auna S kusan 25.5 m² a θ=45° (kuskuren ma’auni ±0.3 m²).
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Hasashen (가) 36·cos45°≈25.46 ne. Yaya wannan bayani ya canza tabbacin ka ga (가)?
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Hasashen 25.46 na (가) yana cikin kuskuren ma’auni na 25.5, kuma ya bambanta sosai da 18 na (나) da (다). Ya dace a ce tabbacin ka ya ƙaru ko ya riga ya wadatar.
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ya ragu, domin 25.5 ba daidai yake da 25.46 ba.
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka yi watsi da sharadin cewa ma’aunin yana da kuskure. Duba ko ƙimar tana cikin zangon kuskuren.
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ya ƙaru. Hasashen yana cikin kuskuren ma’auni, na (나) da (다) kuwa nesa yake. (18)
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya lura sabon bayani ya dace da hasashen (가), saboda haka tabbaci ya ƙaru.
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Bai canza ba. An riga an cire (나) da (다) a 60°, kuma bayanin 45° bai saɓa wa (가) ba.
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan hukunci ne cewa sabon bayani bai saɓa wa hukuncin da aka riga aka yanke ba.
y-m-70-08.s.s1.reflect: Bayanan farko ba su bambanta zato ba, na biyu sun tace zaɓuɓɓuka, na uku bai canza hukunci ba sai ƙara tabbaci. Wane bayani ya fi sauya hukuncinka kuma me ya sa?
y-m-70-08.s.s2.prompt: Shin ƙa’idar (가) tana aiki ga faranti mai siffar murabba’i mai gefe huɗu maimakon murabba’i daidai? Idan faranti mai faɗi a daidaitaccen alkiblar axis ɗin juyawa da tsawo b ya karkata haka, rubuta sau nawa faɗi, tsawo da faɗin inuwar suke da na asali, tare da dalili.
y-m-70-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo abin da ke faruwa ga tsawon gefen da yake layi ɗaya da axis na karkata da wanda yake tsaye da shi idan aka nuna inuwarsu a ƙasa.

y-m-70-08.s.s2.model.0: Gefe mai faɗi a layi ɗaya da axis ɗin yana nan a a cikin inuwa; gefen tsawo da ya tsaye da shi yana raguwa zuwa b·cosθ. Inuwar murabba’i ce mai faɗi a da tsawo b·cosθ, don haka faɗinta ab·cosθ, wato cosθ ninkin faɗin asali.
y-m-70-08.s.s2.model.1: Faɗi ba ya canzawa, tsawon gefe guda kuma cosθ ne ninkinsa, don haka faɗi ma cosθ ninkin asali ne. A θ=0° yana 1 ninki, a 90° kuma 0, daidai da bayanan.

y-m-70-08.s.s2.model.2: Gefen da ya layi ɗaya da axis ba ya raguwa; gefen da ya tsaye kaɗai ne ya zama cosθ ninki, saboda haka faɗi ma cosθ ninki ne.

y-m-70-10.title: Idan layi yana tsaye da layuka biyu daban a fili guda, shin yana tsaye da filin?
y-m-70-10.topic: Jikuna a sarari: tsayuwar layi da fili (ta direction vectors)
y-m-70-10.goal: Nemo sharadin da ya ɓace a da’awar cewa “idan layi yana tsaye da layuka biyu daban a fili, yana tsaye da filin,” gina misalin karo da ƙa’ida da coordinates, sannan bayyana dalilin sharadin.
y-m-70-10.material: A cikin coordinates na sarari, fili α shi ne z=0 (xy-plane). Direction vector na l shi ne d=(a,b,c), ba vector sifili ba. A ɗauka layuka biyu suna perpendicular idan dot product na direction vectors 0 ne, ko da ba su haɗu ba. Ɗalibi ya ce: “Idan layi l perpendicular ne ga layuka m₁ da m₂ daban a α, to l perpendicular ne ga α.” Direction vector na m₁ shi ne (1,0,0). (0, 1)

y-m-70-10.s.s2.prompt: Idan direction vector na m₁ (1,0,0), na m₂ kuma (−2,0,0) ne, ƙirƙiri vector (a,b,c) guda 3 daban na layukan l da suke perpendicular ga m₁,m₂ amma ba α ba. (Idan perpendicular da α ne, vector (0,0,c) ne.) (1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2)

y-m-70-02.title: Za mu iya sanin tazara daga maki a kan ellipse zuwa ɗayan focus?
y-m-70-02.topic: Sassan conic: ma'anar ellipse (jimillar tazara zuwa focus biyu)
y-m-70-02.goal: Koyi cewa tazara daga maki ɗaya a kan ellipse zuwa focus guda ba ta kayyade tazara zuwa ɗayan ba, faɗi abin da kuma ake buƙata, sannan ka yanke hukunci kan zangon yiwuwar tazara idan an bayar da lissafin.
y-m-70-02.material: A ce F da F′ su ne focus biyu na ellipse, P kuma maki ne a kanta. PF=7 kaɗai aka sani, kana son gano PF′. (Dukkan tsawo suna da ma'auni iri ɗaya. Ana karanta x²/25 da 'x murabba'i bisa 25'.)
y-m-70-02.thinking.1: Faɗi sunan bayanin da ake buƙata.
y-m-70-02.thinking.2: Yi tunani kan zangon ƙimomi masu yiwuwa.
y-m-70-02.prereq.1: Ma'anar ellipse (jimillar tazarori zuwa focus biyun tana tsayayye)
y-m-70-02.prereq.2: Focus na ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b>0) su ne (±c,0), kuma c²=a²−b².
y-m-70-02.s.s1.prompt: Baya ga abin da aka sani yanzu, me kuma ake buƙata domin PF′ ta zama ƙima guda tabbatacciya?
y-m-70-02.s.s1.hint.0: Bayyana da kalmomi menene 'ƙima tsayayye' a ma'anar ellipse.
y-m-70-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ci gaba da PF=7, ka yi tunanin ellipse inda jimilla 12 ce da wadda jimilla 20 ce, ka kwatanta PF′ a kowacce.
y-m-70-02.s.s1.o.a: Tazarar FF′ tsakanin focus biyu (wannan ƙima kaɗai aka ƙara)
y-m-70-02.s.s1.r.a: Ko da an san tazarar focus kaɗai, ba a kayyade jimillar tazara ba. Ko focus iri ɗaya ne, akwai ellipse masu girma dabam da yawa.
y-m-70-02.s.s1.o.b: Haɗin gwiwar y na maki P (wannan ƙima kaɗai aka ƙara)
y-m-70-02.s.s1.r.b: Haɗin gwiwa guda ɗaya na P ba zai gaya matsayin focus ko girman ellipse ba. Bai isa a lissafa PF′ ba.
y-m-70-02.s.s1.o.c: Tsawon babban axis na ellipse (ko lissafin ellipse)
y-m-70-02.s.s1.r.c: Wannan ƙimar ce ke gaya abin da aka kayyade jimillar tazarori zuwa focus biyun a kai a wannan ellipse.
y-m-70-02.s.s1.o.d: Ba a buƙatar ƙarin bayani. PF′ ita ma 7 ce.
y-m-70-02.s.s1.r.d: Ba ka san wane maki ne ba, amma ka yanke cewa tazararsa iri ɗaya ce daga focus biyun. A ina ne P dole ta kasance domin PF=PF′?
y-m-70-02.s.s1.explain: PF+PF′ ƙima ɗaya ce (tsawon babban axis) a kowane wuri na ellipse. Idan ba ka san wannan ƙimar ba, PF=7 kaɗai ba ta kayyade PF′ ba. FF′ ko haɗin gwiwar P guda ɗaya ma ba ya kayyade jimillar, kuma PF′=PF daidai ne kawai idan P tana kan layin tsaye da ya ratsa tsakiyar focus biyun.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.prompt: Yanzu an bayar da ellipse x²/25+y²/9=1. Focus su ne F(4, 0) da F′(−4, 0). (Semi-axis mafi girma 5, ƙarami 3, kuma 4²=5²−3².) A waɗanne maki P a wannan ellipse ne PF=7 zai iya faruwa?
y-m-70-02.s.s2.hint.0: Lissafa PF a ƙarshen dama (5, 0) da na hagu (−5, 0) domin nemo mafi ƙarami da mafi girman ƙimar PF.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.hint.1: Duba ko 7 tana cikin wannan zangon, sannan ka gano PF′ da jimillar tazarori.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.r.a: Wannan mafita ta ɗauki cewa maki yana da tazara iri ɗaya daga focus biyun. Ga irin wannan maki, PF=PF′=5 ake buƙata.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya yi amfani da tsawon babban axis a matsayin bambancin tazarori.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.o.c: Ba zai yiwu ba. PF ba zai wuce semi-axis mafi girma 5 ba.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.r.c: Semi-axis mafi girma ita ce tazara daga cibiyar zuwa ƙarshen ellipse. Ta bambanta da tazara daga focus zuwa maki a kan ellipse.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.r.d: Da alama ka daidaita tsawon babban axis 10 da bambancin tazarori biyu, maimakon jimillarsu.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.explain: Tsawon babban axis 10 ne, saboda haka PF+PF′=10. PF=5−4=1 ne a ƙarshen da ya fi kusa, 5+4=9 kuma a mafi nisa, don haka zai iya zama kowace ƙima tsakanin 1 da 9. 7 yana cikin zangon, don haka PF′=10−7=3.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.prompt: A wannan ellipse ɗaya, ƙirƙiri nau'i-nau'i 3 (p,q) masu tsari inda ainihin maki P yake da PF=p da PF′=q. (Musanya p da q ana ɗauka misali ɗaya ne. Za ka iya amfani da decimal.)
y-m-70-02.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta abin da p+q dole ya zama, sannan ka duba ko zaɓen p guda yana kayyade q.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.hint.1: Gwada p ƙasa da 1 ko fiye da 9, ka yi tunanin ko irin wannan maki zai iya kasancewa a kan ellipse da gaske.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.ok.c1: Jimillar tazarori biyun 10 ce, tsawon babban axis.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.fail.c1: p+q ba 10 ba ne. Menene jimillar tazarori zuwa focus biyun na ellipse nan?
y-m-70-02.s.s3.ok.c2: Yana cikin zangon tazarorin da maki a ellipse zai iya samu.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.fail.c2: Tazarar daga maki a ellipse zuwa focus ba za ta yi ƙasa da 1 ba. Ka tuna tazarar da aka samu a ƙarshen mafi kusa.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.explain: p+q=10, kuma ƙimar PF tana tsakanin 1 (ƙarshen mafi kusa) da 9 (mafi nisa); saboda haka p da q duka dole su kai aƙalla 1. Duk nau'i-nau'i masu tsari inda p yake tsakanin 1 da 9, kamar (3, 7), (5, 5), (1, 9), suna yiwuwa.

y-m-70-04.title: Idan dot products sun yi daidai, shin vectors biyun su ma iri ɗaya ne?
y-m-70-04.s.s2.ok.c1: a·b da a·c sun yi daidai.
y-m-70-04.prereq.0: A ɗauka ɗalibin yana koyon zaɓin Geometry na makarantar sakandare. “H2” alamar wahala da tallafi ce kawai ga wannan aikin, ba yana nufin Ma’aikatar Ilimi ta ware shi ga wani aji ba.
y-m-70-04.topic: Vector a jirgi: siffofin dot product da misalan ƙaryatawa.
y-m-70-04.goal: Gwada da misalin ƙaryatawa ko ƙa'idar sokewa da ke aiki ga lambobi ('idan ab=ac kuma a≠0 to b=c') tana aiki ga dot product na vector ma, sannan ka zaɓi sharuddan da ke sa ta yi aiki.
y-m-70-04.material: Ga lambobi, idan a≠0 kuma ab=ac, to b=c. Jeonghyeok ya ɗauka vector ma haka suke, ya ce: “Idan a=(2, 1), to a·b=a·c yana nufin b=c.” (a·b dot product na a da b ne, wato ƙimar da ake samu idan an ninka sassan sannan aka tara. Dukkan vector suna kan jirgin haɗin gwiwa.)
y-m-70-04.thinking.0: Yi shakku ko ƙa'idar lambobi za a iya amfani da ita ga wasu abubuwa.
y-m-70-04.thinking.1: Gina misalin ƙaryatawa da kanka wanda ya cika sharuddan.
y-m-70-04.thinking.2: Gwada ko ƙarin sharudda sun isa.
y-m-70-04.prereq.1: Siffar bangaren vector a jirgi da dot product a·b=a₁b₁+a₂b₂.
y-m-70-04.prereq.2: Siffofin dot product idan vector biyu suna layi ɗaya ko kuma suna tsaye wa juna.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.prompt: Domin gano ko maganar Jeonghyeok tana aiki kullum, waɗanne (b,c) ne za su fi dacewa a gwada?
y-m-70-04.s.s1.hint.0: Idan iƙirari yana siffar 'idan sharadi to ƙarshe', me misalin da ya rushe iƙirarin dole ya cika, kuma me dole ya karya, sharadin ko ƙarshe?
y-m-70-04.s.s1.hint.1: Da farko zaɓi vector guda da dot product dinsa da a=(2, 1) aka sani, sannan ka sauya sassansa ka nemo wani vector dabam da dot product dinsa iri ɗaya.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.o.a: Gwada nau'i-nau'i da yawa inda b da c vector iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.a: Idan b=c, a·b=a·c yana aiki kullum. Waɗannan ba nau'i-nau'i ne da za su iya rushe iƙirarin ba.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.o.b: Gwada vector masu alkibla iri ɗaya da a kaɗai.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.b: Kana gwada yanayi na musamman kawai. Ko da ya yi aiki a nan, ba za ka iya sanin sauran yanayi ba.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.c: Girman ba shi da alaƙa kai tsaye da ko iƙirarin yana aiki.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.o.d: Nemo nau'i-nau'i inda a·b=a·c amma b≠c.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.d: Tun da iƙirarin ya ce 'kullum', wannan ra'ayi yana neman nau'i-nau'i da suka cika sharadin amma suka saɓa wa ƙarshe.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.explain: Iƙirarin 'kullum' yana rushewa da nau'i-nau'i guda da suka cika sharadin (a·b=a·c) amma suka saɓa wa ƙarshe (b=c). Saboda haka abin da ya fi amfani shi ne ka nemo irin wannan nau'i-nau'i da kanka.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.prompt: Ga a=(2, 1), ƙirƙiri nau'i-nau'i vector 2, b=(b₁,b₂), c=(c₁,c₂), inda a·b=a·c amma b≠c. Nau'i-nau'i biyun dole su sami b−c mabambanta (musanya b da c ko sauya alamar b−c kawai ana ɗaukar misali iri ɗaya).
y-m-70-04.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi b guda, ka lissafa a·b.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.hint.1: Duba nawa a·c yake sauyawa idan ka sauya sashen c guda, sannan ka sauya ɗayan sashen yadda ya dace domin dot product ya koma yadda yake.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Lissafa a·b=2b₁+b₂ da a·c=2c₁+c₂ dabam. Ƙimomin biyu ba su yi daidai ba.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Vectors b da c sun bambanta.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Vectors b da c iri ɗaya ne. Dole su bambanta don zama misali mai karya.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.explain: Misali, idan b=(1;3), c=(2;1), to a·b=2+3=5 kuma a·c=4+1=5 sun yi daidai amma b≠c. b−c koyaushe yana da siffar (t,−2t), alkibla mai tsaye da a. Saboda haka za a iya matsar da vector da kowane nisa a alkiblar da ta tsaye da a.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.prompt: Ka tabbatar da cewa da’awar ba koyaushe take aiki ba. Zaɓi duk ƙarin sharuddan da za su sa “idan a·b=a·c, to b=c” ta zama gaskiya. (a ba vector sifili ba ne.)
y-m-70-04.s.s3.hint.0: Sake rubuta kowane sharadi a matsayin irin vector b−c da ake buƙata. Menene a·(b−c)=0 ke nufi?
y-m-70-04.s.s3.hint.1: Ga kowane sharadi, nemi nau’i-nau’i b≠c kai tsaye idan a=(2; 1). Idan ka samu, wannan sharadi bai wadatar ba.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.o.a: |b|=|c| (vectors biyun suna da girma iri ɗaya)
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.a: Girma iri ɗaya ba yana nufin vector ɗin iri ɗaya ba. Duba ko b=(1; 3), c=(3; −1) sun cika sharadin idan a=(2; 1).
y-m-70-04.s.s3.o.b: a·b=a·c yana aiki ga kowane vector a a jirgin.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.b: Wannan yana canza a yayin sanya sharadin don b−c ya kasance da tsaye ga kowace alkibla.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.c: Ka manta cewa akwai vectors marasa iyaka a layi guda da suke da tsaye da a. Misali, ka yi tunanin (1,−2) da (2,−4).
y-m-70-04.s.s3.o.d: b da c duka suna layi ɗaya da a.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.d: Wannan ya yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa ana iya kayyade vectors a layi guda ɗaya bayan ɗaya ta girmansu (dot product).
y-m-70-04.s.s3.explain: Tun da a·(b−c)=0, ya isa b−c ya kasance da tsaye da a. (b) Idan yana aiki ga kowane a, to b−c yana da tsaye ga kowace alkibla, saboda haka vector sifili ne. (d) Idan b=sa da c=ta, s|a|²=t|a|² yana ba da s=t. (a) Idan b=(1; 3), c=(3; −1), girmansu iri ɗaya ne, a·b=a·c=5, amma b≠c. (c) (1; −2) da (2; −4) duka suna da tsaye da a, saboda haka dot product ɗinsu 0 ne amma sun bambanta.
